To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) teaching is an important part of learning for children and adults; (2) children learn more from teaching than from non-teaching interactions; (3) children and adults are more likely to learn from teaching when it involves language; and (4) the effects of teaching are long-lasting.
